distinctive_features.feature: IB-specific workflows for IBIS registration, CAS, Extended Essay, Theory of Knowledge, Internal Assessments and eCoursework.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These workflows reduce spreadsheet-based coordination and help schools track required IB programme components.

distinctive_features.feature: Curriculum-first planning across more than 600 standards sets and multiple curricula.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can connect learning outcomes, units, assessment and reporting across IB and other programmes.

distinctive_features.feature: Single platform supports IB, Cambridge, IGCSE, Edexcel, AP and custom programmes.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: International schools can manage different curricula within one school environment.

distinctive_features.feature: Configurable multilingual and right-to-left report cards with proofing and rubric support.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can produce locally appropriate, branded reports for varied languages and reporting models.

distinctive_features.feature: Portfolios capture goals, reflections, CAS, projects, coursework and awards.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Students and teachers can document learning evidence beyond grades.

distinctive_features.feature: One native mobile app supports students, parents, teachers, coordinators and administrators.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Multiple school roles can access relevant academic and communication workflows on mobile.

distinctive_features.feature: ManageBac Writing Assistant includes text generation, revision, simplification and translation.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Staff can work with text inside the platform, subject to documented availability limits.

distinctive_features.feature: Public APIs and integrations connect ManageBac with SIS, productivity and assessment tools.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can connect core workflows with systems such as Google Workspace, iSAMS and Turnitin.

weaknesses.issue: Admissions relies on separate OpenApply; fees, HR, transport, library, boarding and other ERP functions are absent or separate.
Pricing is quote-only, with no public per-student price or tier limits.
Reviewers criticized navigation, interface usability and information density.
Mobile reviewers reported confusing navigation and difficulty using task and deadline views.
Some reviewers reported maintenance interruptions or perceived downtime.
The AI Writing Assistant is unavailable in native apps and China, and does not use platform page context.

ai_features: ManageBac Writing Assistant generates, revises, simplifies, expands, corrects and translates text.
AssessPrep, a linked assessment service, offers AI question creation and grading.
pricing_model_summary: Annual subscription priced by student count; quotes required. Two-year prepayment receives 5% off and three-year prepayment 10% off.
biggest_strategic_gap: ManageBac+ is curriculum and academic-management focused, not a full SIS/ERP; many operational functions require separate products or integrations.
